html:
SMTO-GML-0071 — SMTO can't send from that email address

GUID: 46e9d35e-8739-4be4-bdda-07e72c2a7bf1
Slug: gmail-send-as-unverified
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gmail-client-actions

What happened

  • You asked SMTO to send from a different address than the account's main one, but Gmail hasn't confirmed this account is allowed to use that address. Nothing was drafted or sent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to list the "send as" addresses for this Gmail account and check which ones are shown as accepted. Only addresses Gmail has already confirmed for this account can be used as the sender.
  2. Ask SMTO to send the email again without naming a different sender, so it uses the account's main address, or name one of the accepted addresses exactly as listed. Nothing was sent the first time, so it's safe to ask again once the sender is an allowed address.
  3. If the address you need is listed but not accepted, ask the Gmail account's owner to finish confirming it in Gmail first. Gmail itself must confirm the address, and SMTO can't do that step for you.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows the draft or sent email with the address you chose as the sender.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't add a new address or change mail forwarding just to get past this check.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • GmailService._mime looked up the requested send_as address and found no matching send-as identity with verificationStatus accepted, so the draft or send was rejected before anything was created.

What this means

  • MIME construction fetches the selected send-as record, requires the exact email address and accepted verification status, and rejects the request before drafting or sending.

Why this can happen

  • MIME construction fetches the selected send-as record, requires the exact email address and accepted verification status, and rejects the request before drafting or sending.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected account, action arguments and operation reference; do not infer mailbox effects from the error alone.

How to fix it

  • Call gmail.list_send_as for the account. Omit send_as to send from the primary address, or use an identity whose sendAsEmail matches (case-insensitively) and whose verificationStatus is accepted; app-password accounts cannot use send_as at all (gmail_oauth_required). The check in agent_runtime/skills/gmail/service.py (GmailService._mime) runs before any draft or send; do not add aliases or change forwarding to bypass it.
  • Use the primary account address or an existing accepted identity returned by gmail.list_send_as.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use the primary account address or an existing accepted identity returned by gmail.list_send_as.

How to verify the fix

  • The sender resolves to the requested accepted identity before mail is sent.

What not to do

  • Do not create an alias or change forwarding settings to bypass verification.

Technical notes

  • This check rejects new work before its write. It does not undo previous confirmed effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
